reconciliations.material_update: The source-matched audit independently inspects the official SkillZip release and a separate non-fork JavaScript reimplementation. Official artifacts strongly support one-shot and Zip-on-Write mechanism semantics. The separate implementation reconstructs major algorithmic pieces and reports a deterministic paper-derived LiveMath fixture compression of 870 to 752 estimated tokens (13.6%), but it does not reproduce the paper's LLM-assisted 31.2% aggregate or 16-round endpoint results. No full independent numerical rerun or failed full rerun was found.
reconciliations.scope_guard: Do not upgrade the paper headline numbers to independently replicated. The public author release still lacks the fixed accepted-patch chronology, complete SkillOpt/LiveMath orchestration, raw per-round trajectory/result bundle, and final-test replay bundle needed for an exact 16-round reproduction.
reconciliations.reason_no_tier_change: The predecessor already credited strong primary paper/code support while withholding independent long-horizon replay. The new audit materially strengthens mechanism-level reproducibility provenance but does not cross the independent-headline-replication boundary.

reconciliations.material_update: Primary arXiv HTML verifies the adversarial-optimization protocol as 10 iterations with 3 prompt variants per iteration, 31 attempts including seed per defense, same-sized non-overlapping held-out sets, and a four-task SHADE-Arena transfer set with 5 samples each. It explicitly reports Just Ask on Code Backdooring rising from 28% to 68% undetected successful attack under optimization, and states that the combined self-incrimination plus strong-monitor defense was hardest to break across tested conditions.
reconciliations.scope_guard: This exact 28% to 68% result is for Just Ask on Code Backdooring under the paper's GPT-5 proposer-pruner/GPT-4.1 attacker protocol. Do not generalize it to every monitor, task, model family, or prompt-injection setting. The combined-defense conclusion is in-scope comparative evidence, not a universal robustness guarantee.
reconciliations.reason_no_tier_change: The predecessor already assigned A- based on strong primary adaptive-attack evidence with code. Exact primary-text verification sharpens the quantitative scope but does not add independent replication.
